lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Discussion or problem seminar: remainders in context

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: One approach is shown. There is at least one other that works.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: For each, name a second method before you solve it.

items.prompt: Which numerical expression records this calculation? Multiply 24 by 20, then subtract 8 from the product.

choices: Multiply 25 by 30, then subtract 3 from the product.
Subtract 3 from 30, then multiply the difference by 25.
Add 25 and 3, then multiply the sum by 30.

items.prompt: Pattern A starts at 24 and adds 10. Pattern B starts at 23 and adds 5. What are the corresponding terms at term 6?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt:
Pattern A: 14, 16, 18, 20, 22
Pattern B: 28, 32, 36, 40, 44
Which statement describes the relationship between corresponding terms?
choices: Each term in Pattern B is 3 times the corresponding term in Pattern A.
Each term in Pattern A is 2 times the corresponding term in Pattern B.
Each term in Pattern A is 1/3 of the corresponding term in Pattern B.
Each term in Pattern B is 2 times the corresponding term in Pattern A.

items.prompt: Pattern A starts at 4 and adds 12. Pattern B starts at 24 and adds 14. Using Pattern A as x and Pattern B as y, which point represents term 8?
3780 counters are split into 21 equal groups. Which pair of equations represents the model?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Argue for one method over another. Say what makes it better, not just that it is.

items.prompt: A rectangle has area 450 square units and one side length is 18 units. What is the missing side length?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt:
Use these partial-quotients steps to solve 9884 ÷ 86:
9884 - 86 × 110 = 424
424 - 86 × 4 = 80
What is the quotient and remainder?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
